shots.name: Plunger Lane
shots.notes: Manual plunger. Before you shoot, the 8 ball on the upper platform swings back and forth — the skill shot is timed against it.

shots.name: The Ramp
shots.notes: The most important shot on the machine. Two red lamps flashing at its entrance means it will start something — a Wagon Wheel round, Pool Ball Mania, Nine Ball Play, video mode or multiball.

shots.name: Corner Pocket
shots.notes: The eject on the left above the outlane. Relights the Wagon Wheel when it is dark, advances your multiplier, and is the last shot in the Combo round.

shots.name: Side Pocket
shots.notes: The two green targets on the upper platform. You do not hit them with your ball — you hit them with the cue ball. A careless straight-on hit sends the cue ball back down the middle.

shots.name: The Cue Ball
shots.notes: Sits in front of the NO WAY target and blocks it. Hitting it at an angle, like a real pool shot, is safer than hitting it square.

shots.name: NO WAY Target
shots.notes: The white target between the two horseshoe entrances, hidden behind the cue ball. Adds letters to WIZARD when the red lamp behind the cue ball is on.

shots.name: Horseshoe (Left Side)
shots.notes: One mouth of the tunnel under the platform. A hard enough shot carries through and exits the other side.

shots.name: Horseshoe (Right Side)
shots.notes: The other mouth. The value lamps run 2, 5, 10 and 20 million, and collecting one advances the next value to the opposite side.

shots.name: Left Bank Shot
shots.notes: One of two ejects across the top. A clean arrival that touches no bumpers pays points on a rising ladder as well as the award.

shots.name: Right Bank Shot
shots.notes: The other top eject. Neither bank shot is available during multiball or any Wagon Wheel round.

shots.name: Sweet Spot
shots.notes: The white target between the two bank shots. Lit by spelling POOL, worth 50 million, and it stays lit until the ball drains.

shots.name: Solids (1-7)
shots.notes: The drop target bank on the upper left. Backhandable from a trapped ball on the left flipper. Each clear advances a rack.

shots.name: Stripes (9-15)
shots.notes: The upper right bank, and where the 9 ball target lives. Whichever bank has flashing lamps above it is the one that counts toward multiball; the other pays 500,000 a target.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: Touching one on the way in is what turns a clean bank shot into an ordinary one. Bumper hits also swap which of the two red Special targets is lit.

shots.name: Hurry Up Target
shots.notes: The yellow target above the Corner Pocket. Carries the hurry-up Special and the 10 million and 5 million hurry-ups.

shots.name: Change Target
shots.notes: The wagon wheel target above the right outlane. Changes which Wagon Wheel award is queued, or awards the extra ball when the hurry-up is lit.

shots.name: Red Special Targets
shots.notes: Two targets in the top corners. Lit by pushing the multiplier to 7, and only one is live at a time — every bumper hit swaps sides. Spelling WIZARD makes them worth 5 million each.

shots.name: Wagon Wheel
shots.notes: The award display above the flippers. Whichever round is flashing here is the one the lit ramp will start. Check it before you shoot.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: Carries one letter of P-O-O-L. Either flipper button rotates which lanes are lit, so you should never collect the same letter twice.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Another P-O-O-L letter. Completing the word lights the ramp for video mode and lights the Sweet Spot.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Carries a P-O-O-L letter of its own.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: The last of the four P-O-O-L lanes.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the ramp and, on a backhand from a trap, the Solids bank and sometimes a bank shot.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the Corner Pocket and the left side of the playfield.

goals.title: Break Skill Shot
goals.summary: The 8 ball on the upper platform swings left and right before you plunge. Time the plunge so your ball drives the 8 ball into the blue targets. It takes practice because you have to lead the swing rather than shoot at it.

steps.action: Time the plunge to drive the 8 ball into the blue targets
steps.detail: The 8 ball on the upper platform swings left and right before you plunge — lead the swing rather than shooting at where it is now. Five million, and a shot worth practising because you get one every ball.

goals.title: The Wagon Wheel
goals.summary: The spine of the whole game. One ramp shot lights the ramp for a Wagon Wheel round, and the next ramp shot starts whichever round is flashing on the wheel above the flippers. Work through all six and the ramp lights for Pool Ball Mania.
goals.reward: Six timed rounds, then Pool Ball Mania

steps.action: Light the wheel with a ramp shot
steps.detail: The ramp is already lit for the first award as soon as you plunge.

steps.action: Or relight it from the Corner Pocket
steps.detail: The Corner Pocket lights the wheel whenever the ramp is dark.
The wagon wheel target above the right outlane cycles which round is queued.

steps.action: Shoot the lit ramp to start it
steps.detail: Check the wheel first. The round you get is the one flashing, not the one you want.

goals.title: Rowdy Ramp
goals.summary: The simplest round and one of the best. Keep shooting the ramp before the timer runs out. The awards climb steeply — 2 million, then 5, 10, 20 and 40 million — and the ceiling can be collected more than once.

steps.detail: The first shot is only worth two million, so the value is entirely in stringing them together.

steps.action: Live at the top of the ladder
steps.detail: Once you reach 40 million each further shot pays it again.

goals.title: Horseshoe Extra Ball
goals.summary: The shortest round in the game. Once it starts, put the ball into either mouth of the horseshoe and you have an extra ball. There is nothing else to it, so if this is the flashing award, take it immediately.

steps.detail: Left or right, whichever your flipper is set up for.
A quick second horseshoe is rumoured to award a second extra ball, but it is not something you can count on.

goals.title: NO WAY
goals.summary: Thirty million per hit on a target the cue ball is deliberately parked in front of. You either knock the cue ball aside and shoot the gap, or find a bank that goes around it.

steps.action: Start it and take the return
steps.detail: The ramp feeds the ball back to the left flipper as the round begins.

steps.action: Let it roll to the flipper tip
steps.detail: Waiting for the tip and then flipping sends the ball off the right slingshot at the right angle.
That carom finds the target far more reliably than a straight shot into the cue ball.

goals.title: Spell DOUBLE
goals.summary: The highest-leverage round on the machine. The Corner Pocket takes the first letters and the ramp adds more until time runs out. Complete the word and all scoring, every extra ball and every special is doubled for the rest of that ball.
goals.reward: Everything doubled until the ball drains

steps.detail: That is the first shot of the round and it may award several letters at once.

steps.action: Add the rest at the ramp
steps.detail: Keep ramping until the word is complete or the clock stops you.
A bank shot award will sometimes hand you the last letters outside the round entirely.

goals.title: Combo Shots
goals.summary: Three countdown shots in a fixed sequence. The ramp counts down from 10 million, either bank shot from 20 million, and the Corner Pocket from 50 million. Let any of those countdowns reach zero and the round is over.
goals.reward: Up to 80 million across three shots

steps.detail: Every second you spend lining it up costs you money.

steps.action: Then either bank shot, from 20 million
steps.detail: Left or right, whichever is available off the return.

steps.action: Finish at the Corner Pocket, from 50 million
steps.detail: The biggest of the three, and the one worth rushing to.

goals.title: Side Pocket Round
goals.summary: Ten million every time you drive the cue ball into the side pocket before the timer stops, and each one also advances a rack toward your end-of-ball bonus. Angle your hits — a square shot into the cue ball is a drain waiting to happen.

steps.action: Cut the cue ball, do not smash it
steps.detail: Hitting it at an angle keeps the rebound out of the middle.
Ten million a shot and one rack, which feeds directly into your bonus.

steps.action: Stack it with multiball if you can
steps.detail: Starting this round alongside two-ball play lets you collect jackpots and side pocket awards in the same breath.

goals.title: Two Ball Multiball
goals.summary: Clear the flashing drop target bank, hit the side pocket when it flashes 8 Ball, then shoot the ramp. Jackpots come from driving the 8 ball into the three colour sets on the platform, and any drop target adds a million to whatever jackpots are left.

steps.detail: The lamps above one bank flash to show which side counts. The other bank still pays 500,000 a target.
This is what actually lights the ramp for multiball.
Every drop target you hit during multiball adds a million to each jackpot still uncollected.
All three colour jackpots light the ramp for 100 million, and taking it resets the whole cycle.

goals.title: Pool Ball Mania
goals.summary: Finish all six Wagon Wheel rounds and the ramp lights for a three-ball multiball where every target on the playfield is worth 5 million. It ends when two of the three balls drain — and the whole total only pays out once your balls are gone, so a tilt costs you everything.

steps.detail: Rowdy Ramp, Horseshoe Extra Ball, NO WAY, Spell DOUBLE, Combo Shots and Side Pocket.
Do not shoot the ramp for this while you are already in two-ball play — it will not give you the third ball.
The NO WAY shot, both drop banks, the change targets and the side pocket all pay. Slingshots, bumpers and lanes do not.
None of it is banked until every ball has drained. A tilt throws the entire round away.

goals.title: Nine Ball Play
goals.summary: After Pool Ball Mania the ramp lights for the biggest shot in the game. Clear the 1 through 7 drop targets, hit the 8 ball in the side pocket, and the 9 ball target lights for 500 million — a full billion if DOUBLE is running.

steps.detail: The ramp only holds Nine Ball Play for about a minute and a half before it resets to Rowdy Ramp.
The Solids bank on the upper left.
This lights the 9 ball target.
That is the whole window. Miss it and the wheel resets and you start the cycle again.

goals.title: The Nine Ball Shortcut
goals.summary: A sequencing trick that removes most of the work from the half-billion shot. Set up the 8 ball before Pool Ball Mania starts, refuse to spend it during the multiball, and Nine Ball Play collapses into a single target.

steps.action: Clear the flashing bank before you start Mania
steps.detail: That lights the 8 ball at the side pocket, which is normally the multiball trigger.

steps.action: Start Pool Ball Mania with it still lit
steps.detail: You are deliberately carrying the lit 8 ball into the round.

steps.action: Do not touch the side pocket during Mania
steps.detail: Spending the 8 ball here throws the whole plan away.
With the 8 ball already banked, Nine Ball Play skips straight to the lit 9 target.

goals.title: Work the Bank Shots
goals.summary: The most consistently profitable habit on the machine. A clean arrival that touches no bumpers pays points on a rising ladder — 1, 2, 5, 7, 10, 15 and 20 million — plus a random award. The bank shot lamps flashing tell you the next one will be clean.
goals.reward: Up to 20M plus a random award

steps.action: Go in without touching a bumper
steps.detail: Brush a bumper on the way and you get the award but none of the points.
Awards range from multiplier and rack advances to extra balls, spotted WIZARD and DOUBLE letters, video mode and starting the current wheel round.

steps.action: Farm them after Pool Ball Mania
steps.detail: Every bank shot is treated as clean from the end of Mania until Nine Ball Play is over — the easiest 20 million and extra ball in the game.

goals.title: Spell POOL
goals.summary: One letter sits in each inlane and outlane, and either flipper button rotates which ones are lit — so there is no excuse for wasting one. Completing the word lights the ramp for a video mode and lights the Sweet Spot.
goals.reward: Video mode and a lit Sweet Spot

steps.action: Rotate before the ball rolls through
steps.detail: Both flipper buttons move the lit lanes, which makes repeats avoidable.
The catching game pays 2, 5, 10 and 20 million as you collect balls. The curtain-picking one gives the same award whichever curtain you choose, so relax through it.
The Sweet Spot stays lit until the ball drains, and it can be relit more than once a ball.

goals.title: Spell WIZARD
goals.summary: Letters come from the NO WAY target, but only while the red Spell Wizard lamp behind the cue ball is on. Complete the word and NO WAY pays 10 million a shot for the rest of the ball, and both red Special targets become worth 5 million.
goals.reward: 10M per NO WAY shot, 5M per Special target

steps.action: Shoot NO WAY while the red lamp is on
steps.detail: The lamp sits behind the cue ball, so check it before you commit to the shot.

steps.action: Let bank shots fill the gaps
steps.detail: Bank awards spot WIZARD letters and can even complete the word outright.
Five million each once WIZARD is spelled.

goals.title: Racks and Multiplier
goals.summary: Your end-of-ball bonus is 500,000 times racks times multiplier, so both halves matter equally. The Corner Pocket raises the multiplier, the Side Pocket round and cleared drop banks raise racks, and four racks lights the hurry-up extra ball.

steps.action: Push the multiplier with the Corner Pocket
steps.detail: Bank shots sometimes advance it too.
Completing either bank of stripes or solids advances a rack.

steps.action: Take the extra ball at four racks
steps.detail: Four racks lights the hurry-up extra ball at the wagon wheel target.
That is what lights the two red Special targets, and on a machine with a steep replay score it may be your only realistic route to one.

goals.title: Horseshoe Values
goals.summary: The lamps leading into each mouth of the horseshoe run 2, 5, 10 and 20 million. Shoot into whichever side is flashing to collect that value, and the next value up lights on the opposite side — so a full climb means alternating left and right.

steps.detail: Only a flashing lamp pays; an unlit entrance is just a pass-through.
Collecting advances the value and moves it to the opposite side, so the ladder is naturally a left-right-left pattern.

goals.title: Scratch Shots
goals.summary: Putting the cue ball in the side pocket with the 8 ball unlit is a scratch. It is not a penalty — the game counts them, and the third scratch quietly pays 10 million with another award waiting at eight.

steps.action: Do not fear an unlit side pocket
steps.detail: The shot still counts for something, and three of them pay.
The real risk here is not the scratch, it is the rebound coming back down the middle.

goals.title: Stack Rowdy Ramp with Multiball
goals.summary: The single biggest scoring trick on the machine. With multiball lit and Rowdy Ramp queued on the wheel, one ramp shot starts the round and then the multiball, and you end up feeding two balls through a ramp that tops out at 40 million a shot.

steps.action: Set the wheel to Rowdy Ramp
steps.detail: The change target cycles the queued award until Rowdy Ramp is flashing.

steps.action: Have multiball lit at the same time
steps.detail: Clear the flashing bank and take the 8 ball first.
Rowdy Ramp begins, then the multiball sequence. Plunging the second ball hands you two million on its own.

steps.action: Keep both balls on the ramp
steps.detail: The ladder caps at 40 million but you can collect that ceiling over and over.

achievements.title: Clean Break
achievements.desc: Land the plunge skill shot into the blue targets.

achievements.title: Rowdy Ramp
achievements.desc: Reach the 40 million award during a Rowdy Ramp round.

achievements.title: Everything Twice
achievements.desc: Complete DOUBLE to double all scoring for the rest of the ball.

achievements.title: Around The Cue Ball
achievements.desc: Land a 30 million NO WAY hit during the round.

achievements.title: Eight Ball, Side Pocket
achievements.desc: Light and start Two Ball Multiball.

achievements.title: Super Jackpot
achievements.desc: Collect all three colour jackpots and take the 100 million super.

achievements.title: Pool Ball Mania
achievements.desc: Complete all six Wagon Wheel rounds and start the three-ball round.

achievements.title: Spell WIZARD
achievements.desc: Complete WIZARD to make NO WAY worth 10 million a shot.

achievements.title: Half A Billion
achievements.desc: Light and collect the 9 ball for 500 million.

achievements.title: A Billion
achievements.desc: Collect the 9 ball with DOUBLE running.

achievements.title: That's The Bank Shot
achievements.desc: Take a clean bank shot at the top of the 20 million ladder.

achievements.title: Multiplier Seven
achievements.desc: Push the multiplier to 7 and light the red Special targets.

drills.title: Lead The Swinging 8 Ball
drills.text: The 8 ball swings left and right on the platform before you plunge, so time the release against where it is going rather than where it is. You get one of these every ball, which makes it the cheapest five million on the machine.

drills.title: Ramp Ladder Reps
drills.text: String ramp shots together against the clock: two million, then five, ten, twenty, forty. The first shot is worth almost nothing, so the whole value is in how fast you get the next one away.

drills.title: Clean Bank Shots Only
drills.text: Shoot both top ejects and count only the arrivals that never touch a bumper — those are the ones that pay the points ladder as well as the award. Watch the bank shot lamps; they flash when the next one will count as clean.

drills.title: Carom Into NO WAY
drills.text: Let the ball roll all the way to the tip of the left flipper before you flip, so it comes off the right slingshot at an angle. That carom finds the target behind the cue ball far more often than any straight shot at the gap.

drills.title: Cut The Cue Ball
drills.text: Hit the cue ball at an angle the way you would a real pool shot instead of driving it square. A square hit sends the rebound straight back down the middle, and that rebound is the real risk on this shot, not the scratch.

drills.title: Run The Three Countdowns
drills.text: Ramp from ten million, either bank shot from twenty, Corner Pocket from fifty, in that order and without lining anything up. All three are counting down at once and letting any of them reach zero ends the round.

actionButton.how: Two flipper buttons, a start button and a plunger lane — that is the lot. Both flipper buttons double as lane change on the P-O-O-L lanes, which means there is no excuse for collecting the same letter twice.

howItPlays.objective: Run the table like a pool hall, with a real cue ball to shoot and the Wagon Wheel above the flippers deciding which round the ramp will start. Work all six rounds to Pool Ball Mania, then chase the half-billion Nine Ball.
loop: Shoot the ramp to light the Wagon Wheel, read which round is flashing, cycle it at the change target if you want another, then ramp again to start it.
Play out the flashing round -- ramp ladders, DOUBLE, NO WAY, the cue-ball side pocket -- for its points before the timer stops you.
Spell P-O-O-L across the inlanes and outlanes, rotating the lit lanes with the flippers, to light a video mode and the Sweet Spot.
Clear a flashing drop bank and sink the 8 ball to light the ramp for two-ball play and its jackpots.
Finish all six wheel rounds for Pool Ball Mania, then take the ramp into Nine Ball Play for the biggest shot on the table.

lights.name: Wagon Wheel Rounds
lights.lit: A pair of red lamps lit at the ramp means your next ramp shot will start something, and the Wagon Wheel display above the flippers spells out exactly which round is queued.
lights.flashing: Whichever round is flashing on the wheel is the one you get -- read it before you commit the ramp.
lights.then: Cycle the queued round at the change target until you like it, relight the ramp off the Corner Pocket whenever it goes dark, then ramp to begin. Clearing all six rounds lights the ramp for Pool Ball Mania.

lights.name: P-O-O-L Lanes
lights.lit: One letter of P-O-O-L sits in each inlane and outlane, a lit lane is a letter you have not banked yet, and rolling through it claims that letter.

control.effect: either flipper button rotates which P-O-O-L lane lamps are lit, so you can move the letter you still need under the ball and never take the same one twice
control.when: before the ball rolls an inlane or outlane

lights.then: Rotate the lamps to the letter you need, roll it, and finish P-O-O-L to open a video mode at the ramp and turn on the Sweet Spot -- a fat fifty-million target that stays on until you drain and comes back more than once each ball.

lights.name: WIZARD at NO WAY
lights.lit: NO WAY only adds a WIZARD letter while its red Spell Wizard insert is glowing, and the cue ball parks right in front to block it, so cut around the ball or knock it aside to reach the target.
lights.then: Spell WIZARD and NO WAY becomes a repeat ten-million shot you can keep cashing all ball, while both red Special targets jump to five million apiece. Let bank awards spot any letters you cannot reach cleanly.

lights.name: Solids, Stripes & Multiball
lights.lit: Flashing lamps ride above one of the two drop-target banks to mark the side that counts toward multiball, the other bank just pays points a target, and clearing either advances a rack for your bonus.
lights.flashing: The bank wearing the flashing lamps is the live one for multiball -- the other is only worth its per-target points.
lights.then: Clear the flashing bank, cut the cue ball into the side-pocket targets for the 8 Ball, and ramp to begin two-ball play; pump the jackpots with drop-target hits, then cash the hundred-million super at the ramp. Clearing the Solids and sinking the 8 also sets up the Nine Ball.

lights.name: Horseshoe Values
lights.lit: Each mouth of the horseshoe tunnel carries a value lamp climbing two, five, ten and twenty million, only a flashing mouth pays, and an unlit one is just a pass-through.
lights.then: Shoot the flashing side to collect its value, which bumps the next value up and hops it to the opposite mouth, so a full climb naturally alternates left and right. When the horseshoe round is queued, either mouth simply hands you an extra ball.

lights.name: Bank Shots
lights.lit: The two top ejects flash when the next clean arrival will count, a clean bank -- one that brushes no pop bumper on the way in -- pays a rising points ladder plus a random award, and a bumper touch hands you the award but none of the points.
lights.flashing: A flashing bank-shot lamp promises the next arrival there scores as clean.
lights.then: Feed clean banks for climbing points and awards -- multiplier and rack advances, spotted WIZARD and DOUBLE letters, video mode, extra balls. From the end of Pool Ball Mania through Nine Ball Play every bank counts as clean, so farm them hard in that stretch.

lights.name: Racks & Bonus Multiplier
lights.lit: Your end-of-ball bonus is racks times a multiplier, so both halves count, and the Corner Pocket steps the multiplier up while cleared banks and the side-pocket round pile on racks.
lights.then: Push the multiplier at the Corner Pocket and rack up at the banks; reach four racks and the hurry-up extra ball lights at the change target, and drive the multiplier to seven to light the two red Special targets, often your only realistic Special on a steep replay.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Both flipper buttons work as the P-O-O-L lane change: a tap of either one rotates which inlane and outlane lamps glow, sliding the letter you still need into the ball's path so no lane is ever wasted on a letter already banked. Spell the word and you open a video mode at the ramp plus a lit Sweet Spot worth fifty million.

scoring.text: Time the plunge to drive the swinging 8 ball into the blue targets for the Break skill shot -- you get one every ball. Spell P-O-O-L with the lane change for a video mode and the Sweet Spot, and farm clean bank shots for climbing points and awards.

Feed the ramp to run Wagon Wheel rounds -- ladder Rowdy Ramp toward forty million, finish DOUBLE to double everything for the ball, take NO WAY and the side pocket -- and light two-ball play off a drop bank and the 8 ball. Set the wheel to Rowdy Ramp with multiball ready so one ramp shot starts both and you feed two balls up a forty-million ramp.

Finish all six Wagon Wheel rounds for Pool Ball Mania, then ride the ramp into Nine Ball Play: clear the Solids, sink the 8, and take the 9 for half a billion -- a full billion with DOUBLE running. Carry a pre-lit 8 ball through Mania and the Nine Ball collapses to a single target.
